properties.script:
import json
import re
import sys

organization = sys.argv[1].strip()
definitionName = sys.argv[2].strip()
try: definitionVersion = int(sys.argv[3])
except Exception: definitionVersion = 0
confirmed = sys.argv[4].strip().lower() == "true"
errors = []
if not organization: errors.append("Workload Organization must not be blank.")
if not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9 _-]{0,31}", definitionName): errors.append("Workload Definition Name is invalid.")
if definitionVersion < 1: errors.append("Workload Definition Version must be at least 1.")
if not confirmed: errors.append("Confirm Deletion must be true.")
status, statusCode = ("invalid", 400) if errors else ("ok", 200)
message = " ".join(errors) if errors else "Deletion request is valid."
resultJson = json.dumps({"error":message,"mutationSubmitted":False}, separators=(",",":")) if errors else "{}"
organizationUrl = "/api/v1/organization/Organizations?$filter=Name eq '%s'&$select=Moid,Name" % organization.replace("'", "''")
ready = True

properties.script:
import json
import sys

status = "ok"
statusCode = 200
message = "Organization resolved"
resultJson = "{}"
ready = False
organizationMoid = ""
try:
    body = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
    rows = body.get("Results") if isinstance(body, dict) else None
    if not isinstance(rows, list):
        raise ValueError("Organization response does not contain a Results array.")
    expectedName = sys.argv[2].strip()
    if len(rows) != 1:
        status = "not-found" if len(rows) == 0 else "conflict"
        statusCode = 404 if len(rows) == 0 else 409
        message = "Organization lookup must return exactly one result; received %d." % len(rows)
        resultJson = json.dumps({"error": message, "resultCount": len(rows)}, separators=(",", ":"))
    elif rows[0].get("Name") != expectedName:
        status = "identity-mismatch"
        statusCode = 409
        message = "Organization response does not preserve the exact requested Name."
        resultJson = json.dumps({"error": message}, separators=(",", ":"))
    else:
        organizationMoid = str(rows[0].get("Moid") or "")
        if not organizationMoid:
            raise ValueError("The exact organization result has no Moid.")
        resultJson = json.dumps({"organization": rows[0]}, separators=(",", ":"))
    ready = True
except Exception as exc:
    status = "malformed"
    statusCode = 502
    message = str(exc)
    resultJson = json.dumps({"error": message}, separators=(",", ":"))
    ready = True

properties.script:
import json
import sys

status, statusCode, message, resultJson, ready = "ok", 200, "Exact definition resolved", "{}", False
definitionMoid = definitionItemUrl = ""
try:
    body = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
    name, version, organizationMoid = sys.argv[2], int(sys.argv[3]), sys.argv[4]
    rows = body.get("Results") if isinstance(body,dict) else None
    if not isinstance(rows,list): raise ValueError("Definition response does not contain a Results array.")
    exact = [row for row in rows if row.get("Name") == name and int(row.get("Version",0)) == version and isinstance(row.get("Organization"),dict) and row["Organization"].get("Moid") == organizationMoid]
    if len(exact) != len(rows):
        status, statusCode = "identity-mismatch", 409
        message = "Definition response contains an identity outside the exact requested filter."
        resultJson = json.dumps({"error":message,"returnedCount":len(rows),"exactCount":len(exact)}, separators=(",", ":"))
    elif len(exact) != 1:
        status = "not-found" if len(exact) == 0 else "conflict"
        statusCode = 404 if len(exact) == 0 else 409
        message = "Definition identity must resolve exactly one result; received %d." % len(exact)
        resultJson = json.dumps({"error":message,"resultCount":len(exact)}, separators=(",", ":"))
    else:
        definitionMoid = str(exact[0].get("Moid") or "")
        if not definitionMoid: raise ValueError("Selected definition has no Moid.")
        definitionItemUrl = "/api/v1/workload/WorkloadDefinitions/" + definitionMoid
        resultJson = json.dumps({"selected":exact[0]}, separators=(",", ":"))
    ready = True
except Exception as exc:
    status, statusCode, message = "malformed", 502, str(exc)
    resultJson, ready = json.dumps({"error":message}, separators=(",", ":")), True

properties.script:
import json
import sys

status, statusCode, message, resultJson, ready = "ok", 200, "Inactive definition identity verified", "{}", False
definitionMoid = definitionItemUrl = selectedResultJson = ""
try:
    body = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
    expectedMoid, expectedName, expectedVersion, expectedOrganization = sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3], int(sys.argv[4]), sys.argv[5]
    organization = body.get("Organization") if isinstance(body, dict) else None
    if not isinstance(body, dict) or body.get("Moid") != expectedMoid or body.get("Name") != expectedName or int(body.get("Version", 0)) != expectedVersion or not isinstance(organization, dict) or organization.get("Moid") != expectedOrganization:
        status, statusCode, message = "identity-mismatch", 409, "Definition identity changed between collection and item reads."
    elif body.get("Status") != "Inactive":
        status, statusCode, message = "not-inactive", 409, "Only a workload definition with exact Status Inactive can be deleted."
    else:
        definitionMoid = expectedMoid
        definitionItemUrl = "/api/v1/workload/WorkloadDefinitions/" + expectedMoid
        selectedResultJson = json.dumps(body, separators=(",",":"), ensure_ascii=False)
        resultJson = selectedResultJson
    if status != "ok": resultJson = json.dumps({"error":message,"mutationSubmitted":False}, separators=(",",":"))
    ready = True
except Exception as exc:
    status, statusCode, message = "malformed", 502, str(exc)
    resultJson, ready = json.dumps({"error":message}, separators=(",",":")), True

properties.description: Accepts only HTTP 404 as verified absence and rejects a surviving 2xx item without returning ambiguous success.
properties.script:
import json
import sys

status, statusCode, message, resultJson, ready = "ok", 200, "Deleted definition absence verified", "{}", False
deletedResultJson = "{}"
try:
    verificationCode = int(sys.argv[1])
    deleteCode = int(sys.argv[2])
    selected = json.loads(sys.argv[3])
    if verificationCode != 404:
        status, statusCode, message = "still-present", 409, "Definition still returned after DELETE; absence was not verified."
        resultJson = json.dumps({"error":message,"deleteStatusCode":deleteCode,"verificationStatusCode":verificationCode}, separators=(",",":"))
    else:
        deletedResultJson = json.dumps({"deleted":True,"definition":selected,"deleteStatusCode":deleteCode,"verificationStatusCode":verificationCode}, separators=(",",":"), ensure_ascii=False)
        resultJson = deletedResultJson
    ready = True
except Exception as exc:
    status, statusCode, message = "malformed", 502, str(exc)
    resultJson, ready = json.dumps({"error":message}, separators=(",",":")), True

Deletes one exact inactive Cisco Unified Edge workload definition version only after explicit confirmation and a zero-count deployment preflight. The workflow verifies exact Name, Version, Organization, Moid, and Status before DELETE, never returns a deployment collection, and confirms absence by an exact Moid GET that must return HTTP 404. The workload DELETE route has no If-Match parameter in the local February or newer official schema, so a status or deployment race can still occur after preflight; Cisco Intersight remains authoritative and live-tenant validation is required. A repeated run returns exact not-found rather than silently claiming deletion.
